summary: Implements BIO-BIO-008 (liveness provider contract and policy hooks). AC01: Domain/LivenessEvidence.cs carries ProviderId/Method/ProviderVersion/Confidence/Status, produced by the only ILivenessProvider implementation, SyntheticLivenessProvider (no real anti-spoofing model exists anywhere in this repo, same constraint every synthetic provider here documents). AC02: LivenessStatus (Live/SpoofDetected/Inconclusive) shares no member, name or type with any face-match outcome; this project has zero ProjectReference to BIO-BIO-005, so it structurally cannot even see that story's own MatchOutcome/VerificationResult types - proven by a reflection-based governance test. AC03: ILivenessPolicy/InMemoryLivenessPolicy is tenant+workflow-keyed, defaulting every unconfigured pair to NOT required. AC04: Domain/AdversarialCaseKind.cs + AdversarialSampleFactory.cs is the 'test interface' - a named factory producing a deterministic, tagged synthetic sample per Replay/ScreenPresentation/PhotoPresentation case that SyntheticLivenessProvider recognises and answers SpoofDetected for. AC05: Modules/BioBio008Module.cs maps POST /api/v1/biometrics/face/liveness - the EXACT path and { outcome, message, simulated } response shape web/features/biometrics/live.ts (BIO-UX-008) already targets. After Kemi's approval, checkLiveness is now a genuinely independent, LIVE-capable BiometricService port (round 2) - proven both by automated tests (bio-bio-008-liveness-port.test.ts) and a manual real-host/real-dev-server end-to-end check. BiometricService's other four actions remain untouched, SIMULATION-only under primaryAction.
